plain: A craft said to have crashed near Cape Girardeau may have been brought down by radar from Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio. A former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, named John Blitch offers this to Michels as a guess: if something "was interdicted in the vicinity of Wright-Patterson and if it was traveling fast enough, it could have crashed right there." That would mean the military could knock such craft out of the sky.
